privacy.title: Privacy and your data

points.data: We keep your name, email, mobile, company, trucks, trips, cargo and money numbers. Only people in your company can see them.
points.location: Driver location is used only while the driver has the Spareway map open and agreed to it. We keep only the last point on the trip, not a history.
points.photos: Cargo photos are deleted after 30 days. The items and sizes read from them stay.
points.links: Loader and driver links stop working 48 hours after the trip ends. You can switch them off at any time.
points.email: Emails come only from Spareway (monthly report, important changes). Switch them off above.
points.never: We never sell your data or show it to other transporters.

privacy.deleteText: Your login is deleted. If nobody else is in your company, the company and all its trucks, trips, loads and photos are deleted too. This cannot be undone.
